key_concepts: Earth's lithosphere is broken into tectonic plates that float on the asthenosphere
Plate boundaries are classified by relative plate motion as convergent, divergent, or tran
Convergent boundaries occur where plates move toward each other and are destructive

Divergent boundaries occur where plates move apart and are constructive

Transform boundaries occur where plates slide past each other and crust is neither created
Friction and pressure buildup at transform boundaries can cause strong earthquakes
Transform boundaries are characterized by long faults and often offset mid-ocean ridges
